name: Kaust, Eyes of the Glade
oracle_text:
Whenever a creature you control that was turned face up this turn deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
{T}: Turn target face-down attacking creature you control face up.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a creature you control that was turned face up this turn deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
{T}: Turn target face-down attacking creature you control face up.

needs.what: an op that turns a targeted face-down permanent face up for free (702.37e / 708.8 style, no morph/disguise cost paid), firing the turned_face_up event; objects e.g. {"target": "t1"} over a target spec with face_down: true, attacking: true, controller: you
needs.why_existing_wont_do: ops has no face-flip op: manifest/manifest_dread/cloak only create face-down permanents, exile_and_return returns face up but leaves combat and resets the object, and the only way face up today is the special action of paying a morph cost; the turned_face_up trigger event exists but nothing an effect can do raises it

needs.what: a selector/trigger-filter key matching a permanent that was turned face up this turn (a per-turn flag set when the permanent turns face up), usable in a deals_combat_damage_to_player trigger's filter with controller: you and types: [Creature]
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector_keys and trigger_filter_keys have face_down (current state) and entered_this_turn / attacked_this_turn / surveilled_this_turn, but nothing recording that a permanent turned face up this turn; face_down: false would match every face-up creature
